name: transcriptx
description: Transcribe videos, podcasts and audio or video files into text with timestamps, right in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
TranscriptX turns speech into text right inside your conversation. Paste a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X or podcast link, share a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive file, or attach an audio or video file, and ask ChatGPT to transcribe it.

While it works, a small card shows each step. When it's done, you get the transcript with timestamps — and speaker names when available — plus buttons to copy the text, export .txt, .srt or .vtt, and open the full transcript in TranscriptX to read or edit.

TranscriptX does one thing: transcription. It doesn't read your other messages and doesn't change how ChatGPT answers — once the transcript is back, keep chatting as usual: summarize it, translate it, pull out quotes or action items.

Works in many languages. You can start as a guest; sign in with Google to keep your transcripts in your TranscriptX history.
capabilities: Transcribe audio and video files attached in the chat
defaultPrompt: Transcribe the audio file I attached
Transcribe this podcast and list the key points

positive.expected_behavior: Calls transcribe with the link. A TranscriptX card shows progress, then the transcript with timestamps and Copy / Export / Edit buttons; the text includes a link to the full transcript.

positive.prompt: Transcribe https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw and summarize it in 3 bullet points.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls transcribe (and get_transcript if the transcript is not finished yet), then ChatGPT writes a 3-bullet summary based on the transcript text.

positive.prompt: Transcribe the audio file I attached.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls transcribe_file with the attached file. The card shows 'Receiving file' then the finished transcript of the short meeting recording.
Calls transcribe with the direct audio URL and returns the transcript of the short meeting recording.

positive.prompt: Transcribe the attached meeting recording and list the action items.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls transcribe_file, then ChatGPT lists the action items mentioned in the transcript.

negative.prompt: Translate 'Good morning, how are you?' into French.
Write a short poem about the ocean.

negative.description: Summarize text the user already pasted
negative.prompt: Summarize this paragraph: The quarterly report shows revenue grew 12% while costs stayed flat, mainly thanks to lower cloud spending.

review.commerce_description: No purchases happen inside ChatGPT. When a free daily limit is reached, TranscriptX stops and links only to the public pricing page.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: transcribe links and attached audio/video files, with a progress and result card.
